Trump Rants Over Vandalism Claims Amid Reflecting Pool Repair Issues

President Donald Trump expressed anger over alleged vandalism at a World War II memorial, questioning the origin of "these animals." This statement followed a claim by Trump about vandalism at the Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool, which reports indicate was a "made-up, face-saving vandalism claim" related to botched renovation work. The poor repair of the Reflecting Pool is also noted as potentially damaging the National Park Service's reputation.
